claim: SC04-A: native composition grounds a bounded relational-language domain in exact, scoped source spans and independent artifact observations. SC04-B: those readings cause useful candidate participation or a source-specific inquiry, while unvalidated model proposals remain candidates.
non_claims: Controlled relational English and explicitly declared interface meanings; not arbitrary human-language understanding, all nine complete enactors, a physiological classifier, general VoiceRNA, a live model benchmark, production ingress authentication, G22, promotion, or Mattermost. Held-out claims are limited to undisclosed generated instances inside the frozen grammar/domain.
rationale: SC03 establishes a durable recurring native workload, but its purposes and commitments remain structured laboratory inputs. S-502/505 and ratified D-04 next require a bounded grounded-language experiment before candidate-generation and voice rejoin work. Do not promote a parser alone into the whole semantic solution.
reading: At SC03 closure re-read Soul Part 5 in full, §§9.1–9.5, 6.6–6.7, 11.1–11.5 and entire Appendix A interface ledger; Constitution C-020–025/050–057/060–067/090–098. Re-read the applicable full clauses again at SC04 opening and closure. Ratified D-04 and M24/M25 standing/materiality meanings remain operative.
representation: Raw source plus exact token/span anchors, declared entity/interface bindings, compositional reading proof, inherited origin/scope/current-version roots, alternative readings and defeat conditions. Typed native inquiry and candidate-participation products remain inert until a later certified effect boundary.
consumer: Native MeTTa language composition and semantic admission feed SC01/SC02 relational construction. Prolog only tokenizes raw text with offsets. JavaScript is offline test/evidence tooling; never runtime reasoning or core services.
falsifiers: plan.md freezes constructive alternatives and completion, syntactic composition/negation/modal distinctions, source/scope/version and model-invention attacks, positive/severed/neutral/restored arms, exact-span independent verification, and implementation-before-generated-instance disclosure.
scope_review: plan.md and rejoin-dependencies.md preserve full compass/general language/VoiceRNA/workshop gaps. This gate is a finite dependency, not permission to resume G22. No existing mechanical evidence is rerun before the user-requested pause except SC regressions affected by a changed shared consumer.
rollback: Additive language module and lexical membrane; at most factor a reusable proof-consumer from participation_support.metta without changing existing SC02 outcomes. Preserve controls, seed genome/integrity, archives, old voice/workshop and unfinished G22. Revert explicitly while retaining raw attempts.
